bestBets.overview: Chris Waller has 8 of the 14 but is left with 5 of 11 after scratchings. We note he has provided the quinella of this race every year since Anamoe won it in 2022, and the trifecta last year. All but a couple return from a spell but that's always going to be the case with a 1400m G1 on August 22. The raceday scratching of BEIWACHT robs the race of its obvious leader so I guess we know turn to LINDERMANN crossing up. Our two faves draw low and will be happily tracking the front half. AUTUMN GLOW will be our favourite and given she has lost only once (at a trip she very likely never goes near again) she is an obvious starting point. AELIANA is our current Melbourne Cup favourite and was only narrowly beaten in this race 12 months ago. All that said, SHEZA ALIBI was breathtaking last prep and the fact they make the trip back to Randwick for her return means I simply have to be in her corner, despite a barrier that has the potential to be a little constricting.
